title: Line sketch: Cosmic Bubbles
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: Translucent spheres and a central pod-like form float against a void, with smaller bubbles scattered throughout. The composition balances overlapping circular shapes of varying opacity and color, creating depth through clean lines and soft gradients. Flat color fields and minimal shading evoke a graphic, illustrative technique (derived from painting #152).
